title: Fourier coefficient
statement: Given a complex Fourier system on finite sets $\Omega$ and $\iota$, a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{C}$, and an index $i\in\iota$, define the $i$th Fourier coefficient of $f$ to be its coordinate at $i$ in the basis of the system.
hypotheses_covered: A complex Fourier system on $\Omega$ and $\iota$
